name: Door God: General Yuchi Gong (Hu Jingde) in Operatic Stage Costume on Horseback
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；early 20th century；Woodblock print; ink and color on paper; with printed shop inscription reading "Ju Zao". Probably from Xi'an, Shaanxi; possible pair with 1935.37.91, which has a printed shop inscription reading "Fu Xing" (together their inscriptions read "Fu Xing Ju Zao", "Made by Fu Xing Ju").
